summary: Priced on Sun's own booking page: $70-87/night incl. fees for a May 2027 night; confirmed military discount; added full hookups (50A), pull-throughs, showers/Wi-Fi, year-round, Campspot-powered booking, and a winter 28-night minimum (January and March 2027 arrivals). Note trimmed of rating text.
flags: Mostly seasonal in winter (five-test rule): every RV site type requires 28 nights for January and March 2027 arrivals ('There is a 28 night minimum over the requested period of time'); one-night stays were sold only for the May date read. Homes for sale and annual sites are marketed. Possibly a drop under the 3+-night standing-minimum rule for the winter season.
Over the US$50 gate: cheapest RV night $70 incl. fees (Cozy Full Hookup, 2027-05-18). No gateway within 40 km (nearest Tampa 95 km). The family has not stayed here.
Cozy sites take 'up to 27 feet with zero slides'; every other type takes any size, so a 23-ft motorhome fits throughout.
